args.reason: Add a dB-level Embedded Python block writing to level_db.dat.

final_text: I added an Embedded Python block after the offset that outputs 20 * log10(|x|) with a -120 dB floor, and a File Sink writing it to level_db.dat; the level runs from about -16.5 dB to -0.45 dB. I saved the block to the library as db_level (label dB Level) and saved the flowgraph. dac_test.dat is unchanged.
